Name: Modest Maps Forest Farm
Author: InkubusMods
Description:
[b][u]::  OVERVIEW ::  [/u][/b]
The Modest Forest Map is a redesigned Forest Farm, meant to capitalize on the space provided by the vanilla map, while adding a few tweaks here and there for A more clean and OCD-Friendly workspace.
[u]
[b]::  FEATURES ::  [/b][/u][list]
[*]Large grass field you[u][b] can grow crops on[/b][/u].
[*][u]15 respawning[/u] hardwood stumps.
[*]Small [u]pond for easy water[/u] access far from home.
[*]Natural[u] forage can grow everywhere[/u]!
[*]A quaint work yard.
[*]Easy access to spouse area and cave!
[/list]
[b][b][u][u]::  REQUIRES ::  [/u][/u]
[/b][list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*][b]Yep.[i] That's all.[/i][/b]
[/list][/b]
[b][u][b][b]::  [/b][/b]MANUAL INSTALLATION[b][b] ::  [/b][/b][/u][/b]
Download the file.
Extract the Folder from the Zip.
Put extracted folder into:
﻿Steam>Steamapps>Common>StardewValley>Mods.
Load game with SMAPI.
Enjoy.
[b][b]
[/b][u]::  KNOWN ISSUES::[/u]
Check Nexus bug reports. If you've found something not there, please post it and I will try to assist.
[/b]
